stdout:
Delete live chat moderators. Use this tool to remove moderators from a live chat by their IDs.

Usage:
  yutu liveChatModerator delete [flags]

Examples:
# Delete a live chat moderator by ID
yutu liveChatModerator delete --ids abc123
# Delete multiple live chat moderators
yutu liveChatModerator delete --ids abc123,def456

Flags:
  -h, --help          help for delete
  -i, --ids strings   IDs of the live chat moderators to delete
      --yes           Confirm the operation
